description: Several nested plastic bowls sit on the bed in front of you, with a pillow propped up at the head. The left hand stays resting near the bottom while the right hand reaches in from the right, grips the top bowl as a right-hand object, lifts it up and away to the back-right to unstack it, then returns to pull additional bowls apart and set them down in separate small groups to the right and center before releasing.
